title: Preserve Whole Object

solutions.title: Score the seat, not its fields
solutions.tradeoff: Ties the scoring function to the Seat type, so it can never be reused for anything that isn't a seat - which is exactly why the shared positionScore helper underneath it does not get the same treatment.

reviewFocus: Does `seatScore` take a whole `Seat` now, or did the refactor stop halfway with one of its three fields still passed loose?
Was `positionScore` also changed to take a whole object? If so, check what `bestStandingSpot` would now have to do to keep calling it - that is the dependency-direction argument failing in real time.
Does the walkthrough say why `seatScore` deserved the whole object and `positionScore` didn't in terms of what each function would have to import, not just 'one is bigger than the other'?
Is `bestUpgradeCandidate`'s duplicated three-argument call - once for `seat`, once for `best` - actually gone, or does one of the two copies still destructure the seat by hand?
Does the walkthrough distinguish this from Introduce Parameter Object (drill-06-08) by whether `Seat` already existed before this refactoring touched it, rather than just by which functions changed?
